name: match_native_functions
description: Match two retained list_procedures inventories by unique exact reported symbols, then unique identical observed function bytes. Optional same-context list_names/procedure_info/read_bytes/analyze_function Evidence supplies symbol origin, exact bodies, bytes and dossier links as supplied static facts. Optional compatible CFG/call/string fingerprints from supplied dossiers propose unresolved groups only. Duplicate candidates remain unresolved groups; only_left/right mean unpaired within supplied observations, never proof of addition/removal. Default summary retains complete Evidence for filtered, selected-column, paged function-matches views. Complete detail returns every group. Existing dossier pairs provide direct retained-reference compare_functions inputs.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

left.description: Left list_procedures Evidence or exact retained reference

left_observations.description: Optional same-context list_names, procedure_info, read_bytes or analyze_function Evidence

right.description: Right list_procedures Evidence or exact retained reference
